svg.title: Retrieval routes to the decision instead of running one fixed pipeline for every query.
svg.desc: A decision about what the current step needs routes to no retrieval for general or parametric facts, a single-shot lookup with rerank for straightforward evidence needs, or an iterative multi-step retrieval for complex or multi-hop questions. There is no universal best top_k, chunk size, hybrid weight, or reranker cutoff — tune the whole path against questions with known supporting evidence.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Route retrieval to the decision, not a fixed pipeline

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Tune top_k, chunking, and rerank cutoffs against labeled evidence.
